Definition: adverb from G4053; superabundantly:--exceedingly, out of measure, the more.
BiblicalUsage: Perissos is the adverb exceedingly, out of measure. Paul says he was exceedingly mad against the Christians and persecuted them even to strange cities, and the disciples were astonished out of measure, asking, “Who then can be saved?”
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that “exceedingly” cuts both ways: Paul's madness against the church and the disciples' astonishment at grace — both out of measure.
